title: 第17章 六月叩血门三载熬筋骨第18章 检测到可推演武学玄鹰桩是否推演
slug: 每日情报从打渔人开始武道通神
lines: 两人沿着游廊，在武馆内走了一圈。
前院开阔，铺着青石，乃是外院弟子演武、打熬气血之地。
穿过雕花垂花门，便是内院。
此处景致雅致许多。
假山堆叠，一泓活水蜿蜒而下，潺潺细响，墙角种了一片竹林，残雪积于叶上。
这里便是内院弟子修行、考校武艺的所在。
至于后院，徐川特意指了指月洞门，压低声音道：
“那是师父与大师姐的清修起居之地，未得传唤，万万不可擅入。”
“师弟明白。”
此外，膳堂、耳房、兵库、浴堂等一应俱全。
还有几间供弟子歇息的舍房，窗明几净，瞧着甚是齐整。
前后走了一遍，徐川停下脚步，神色一正，开始立规矩。
“沈师弟，咱们武馆对外院弟子的规矩不多，只有两条不可逾越。”
“其一，不可在外随意打出武馆名号，仗势欺人、惹事生非。”
“其二，要尊师重道，同门不得相残，否则，师父必会亲手清理门户，你可记下了？”
沈修寒认真听完，拱手：“师弟谨记于心！”
规矩立罢，沈修寒等了片刻，终究忍不住问道：
“师兄，那我何时开始练武？”
“你瞧，急了不是？”
徐川好似就在等他这句话，嘿嘿一笑，摇头晃脑：
“武道一途，最重根基。所谓万丈高楼平地起…沈师弟，你可知这武道第一关‘明劲期’的三大门槛？”
沈修寒点点头：
“略知一二，可是练血、练骨、练筋三境？”
“不错。”
徐川笑了笑，念了句武谚：
“六月叩血门，三载熬筋骨，莫道学武不吃苦，偷奸耍滑难成虎！”
“万事开头难，基础尤为紧要，你头几日入武馆，都是由师父亲自督导、传授桩功。”
“待你入了门径，往后才跟着我等一同操练，师父只在考校时出面指点。”
沈修寒恍然，汗颜道：“原来如此，是师弟急躁了…”
“哈哈，不碍事，我等也是从你这般过来的。”
沈修寒顿了顿，又问：
“对了师兄，方才你所说的‘六月叩血门、三载熬筋骨’，又是何意？”
content_en:
The two of them walked along the corridor and around the martial arts hall.
The front yard is open and paved with bluestones. It is the place where the disciples of the outer courtyard practice martial arts and fight to build up their energy and blood.
Passing through the carved hanging flower door is the inner courtyard.
The scenery here is much more elegant.
Rockeries are stacked on top of each other, and a pool of living water meanders down, gurgling softly. A bamboo forest is planted in the corner, with residual snow accumulated on the leaves.
This is where the inner courtyard disciples practice and test their martial arts.
As for the backyard, Xu Chuan specifically pointed to the moon cave door and said in a low voice:
"That is the place where Master and Senior Sister live and practice. You must not enter without being summoned."
"Junior brother understands."
In addition, dining hall, wing room, military storehouse, bathhouse, etc. are all available.
There are also several dormitories for disciples to rest. The windows are bright and clean, and they look very neat.
After walking back and forth, Xu Chuan stopped, looked straight, and began to set the rules.
"Junior Brother Shen, our martial arts school does not have many rules for the disciples of the outer courtyard. There are only two rules that cannot be exceeded."
"First, you cannot use the name of your martial arts school to bully others or cause trouble."
"Secondly, you must respect your master and be respectful, and fellow students must not kill each other. Otherwise, the master will clean up the family with his own hands. Have you written it down?"
After Shen Xiuhan listened carefully, he handed over his hands and said, "Junior brother, please keep this in mind!"
After the rules were established, Shen Xiuhan waited for a moment and finally couldn't help but ask:
"Senior brother, when will I start practicing martial arts?"
"Look, you're in a hurry, aren't you?"
Xu Chuan seemed to be waiting for his words, he smiled and shook his head:
"The most important thing in martial arts is the foundation. The so-called tall buildings rise from the ground... Junior Brother Shen, do you know the three thresholds for the first level of martial arts, the 'Ming Jin Stage'?"
Shen Xiuhan nodded:
"I know a little bit about it, but what about the three realms of blood training, bone training, and muscle training?"
"Not bad."
Xu Chuan smiled and recited a martial proverb:
"Knocking on the door of blood in June, it takes three years of hard work. If you don't learn martial arts without enduring hardship, you can't become a tiger by cheating and slipping!"
"Everything is difficult at the beginning, and the foundation is especially important. In the first few days when you enter the martial arts gym, your master will supervise and teach you the skills."
"After you have entered the door, you can then practice with us. Master will only give guidance during the school exam."
Shen Xiuhan suddenly realized and said with shame: "So that's it. Junior brother is impatient..."
"Haha, it's okay. I came here just like you."
Shen Xiuhan paused and asked again:
"By the way, senior brother, what did you mean by 'knocking on the blood door for six months and enduring the pain for three years' just now?"
title_en: Chapter 17: Knocking on the blood gate in June, three years of hard work Chapter 18: It is detected whether the black eagle pile of martial arts can be deduced
